fato_historico: 2011: The United States military ends its "don't ask, don't tell" policy, allowing gay men and women to serve openly for the first time.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to shed old veils and embrace your true self today. Just as barriers once fell to welcome authentic voices, you may find that expressing your deepest convictions brings profound liberation. It is a good time to release past inhibitions and allow your genuine spirit to shine brightly in every interaction you choose to have.
frase_do_dia: Your truth is a powerful force that illuminates the path to your own freedom.
significado_numero: Represents the master builder and the power of turning dreams into reality.
conselho: Consider speaking your truth openly and watching how the universe aligns with you.
